title: W9 B3 -- Magnify standalone icons on hover and focus
description: Follow section '### B3 --' of docs/agent-work/2026-11-10-ui-wave-9/PLAN.md exactly, plus its 'Rules for every worker'. Verify: tests/w9-icon-magnify.spec.ts and projects-screen spec pass. Browser test port: PLAYWRIGHT_PORT=1436. No commits, no new packages, never run npm run build or a native screen script. Write the note docs/agent-work/2026-11-10-ui-wave-9/notes/B3.md.

handoff.text:
# B3 -- Standalone icon magnification

Added a shared standalone-icon rule for the icon child of `.icon-grow`, project trash and sidebar Open beside buttons. Hover and keyboard focus magnify the child to 1.25 without transforming the button; reduced motion suppresses the magnification. The Projects page can opt in via `.icon-grow` without this task changing its component.

Hand check (not performed): in the built app, hover and keyboard-focus the Projects-page icons/trash and the sidebar Open beside icon in both list and card view; only the icon should grow. Enable Reduce Motion and repeat; icons should not grow. Native/screen checks are deferred to the final wave task per coordinator instruction.

Verification: the initial baseline attempt did not finish within the shell's 120-second foreground timeout and produced no assertion result; it is not counted as fail-first evidence. An acceptance run of `PLAYWRIGHT_PORT=1436 npx playwright test tests/w9-icon-magnify.spec.ts tests/projects-screen.spec.ts` is running in the background and writes to `B3-acceptance.txt`; read its complete result first. Do not assume it passed.

Known follow-up: `createProject` currently returns on the editor page, but the test's `.delete-entry` target exists on the Projects page. Fix the fixture so it asserts trash magnification before opening the project, then creates the two sections and tests Open beside in list and card view. The current browser run may expose this as a fixture failure. Rerun acceptance only after adjusting the test, with no other source edit needed if CSS works.

Handoff: first concrete action is read the complete `B3-acceptance.txt`, then repair the fixture and rerun `PLAYWRIGHT_PORT=1436 npx playwright test tests/w9-icon-magnify.spec.ts tests/projects-screen.spec.ts` with a non-foreground timeout. Do not repeat the initial 120-second run; it yielded no assertion result. No native/screen checks are authorized here.

review.note: Approved (agent-2ff3, W9 reviewer r2). src/components/icon-magnify.css is the plan's one rule: direct svg/span child of .icon-grow, .project-row .delete-entry, .open-beside, .collection-open-beside scales 1.25 on :hover/:focus-visible, span gets inline-block, transition uses the motion tokens, reduced-motion block removes it; the button itself is never transformed. src/hoverEmphasis.test.ts (c) exception checked for narrowness: it accepts exactly one rule, only in src/components/icon-magnify.css, only a selector ending ') > :is(svg, span)', only a body of exactly 'transform: scale(1.25)'. Scratch regex check (no project edits): the real rule matches; a button-level ':is(...):is(:hover, :focus-visible)' scale, '.icon-grow:hover' scale, and a child rule with scale(1.5) all fail it; the same rule in another file fails the file check. Fresh runs: npx vitest run src/hoverEmphasis.test.ts src/derived -> all passed (hoverEmphasis 7/7, (c) green); npx tsc -b exit 0; PLAYWRIGHT_PORT=1436 npx playwright test tests/w9-icon-magnify.spec.ts tests/projects-screen.spec.ts --output test-results/T260-review -> 44/44. Judged only what B3.md describes; projects-screen.spec.ts and ProjectLibrary.tsx also carry T274 edits. Evidence gap: notes/B3-fail-first.txt holds only 'Running 1 test using 1 worker' (no failure output), so B3.md's fail-first claim is unsupported by that file. I accept it by reasoning: without icon-magnify.css the child's computed transform is 'none', so every matrix(1.25) assertion in the spec fails. For T276/D1: the AGENTS.md hover sentence still needs the 25% icon-grow amendment.
